SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, IS_PINNED AS isPinned FROM notification WHERE IS_PINNED = 1 AND TYPE = #{type}
AND ( TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, IS_PINNED AS isPinned FROM notification WHERE IS_PINNED = 0 AND TYPE = #{type}
AND ( TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{startRow}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE IS_PINNED = 0 AND TYPE = #{type} AND ( TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, IS_PINNED AS isPinned FROM notification WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}

SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, TITLE, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID < #{notificationId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY NOTIFICATION_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, TITLE, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID > #{notificationId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY NOTIFICATION_ID ASC LIMIT 1
